title: Throne Hall of Dongola

buildingCutout.basis: Original mapped outline of the standing historic Throne Hall.

terrainReference.basis: Frozen site grade at the western, Nile-facing masonry threshold estimated from the native outline.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap way 908705759 and the University of Warsaw archaeological guide.
mapIdentity.scope: Native standing ruin outline, with documented overall dimensions of approximately 28 m by 18 m by 12 m including the irregular masonry.

note: The original Qualla engraving shows the batter, small upper openings and stair enclosure. University of Warsaw fieldwork describes the roughly 6.5 m ground storey, 3.1 m upper storey, western stair entry and post-conservation roof parapet.
